_comment: The report's executive briefing, pinned for the server (test_report_briefing.py) and the browser engine (web/tests/engine.test.mjs) alike: the same cases, the same words. Every address is RFC 5737, every domain RFC 2606.

cases.name: a critical URL and two high addresses: each address gets its own first step

expected.bottom_line: Contain now. This is a P1: contain within 1 hour.
first_steps: Block the full URL and its parent domain on the web proxy: `hxxps://login[.]example[.]com/owa`.
Block the address at the perimeter firewall and on egress proxies: `198[.]51[.]100[.]7`.
Block the address at the perimeter firewall and on egress proxies: `198[.]51[.]100[.]8`.
expected.how_sure: High. 17 of 18 source lookups answered, and 2 independent sources flagged the lead indicator.

cases.name: one medium domain on thin coverage

expected.bottom_line: Investigate before acting. This is a P3: investigate within 1 business day.
first_steps: Sinkhole or block the domain on the DNS resolver and secure web gateway: `cdn[.]example[.]org`.
Query DNS logs for the last 30 days for resolution attempts and identify the requesting hosts: `cdn[.]example[.]org`.
Add the domain and its known subdomains to the email gateway blocklist: `cdn[.]example[.]org`.
expected.how_sure: Provisional. Only 2 of 7 source lookups answered, so run the case again when the missing sources are back.

cases.name: nothing anyone knows to be bad

expected.bottom_line: No action. This is a P5: record the result and close.
first_steps: No containment action required. Record the triage result against the ticket and close.
expected.how_sure: High. 7 of 8 source lookups answered, and none flagged an indicator at the actionable level.

cases.name: a medium score from several weak signals

expected.bottom_line: Investigate before acting. This is a P3: investigate within 1 business day.
first_steps: Block the address at the perimeter firewall and on egress proxies: `203[.]0[.]113[.]50`.
Search SIEM/NetFlow for the last 30 days of traffic to this address and list every internal host that talked to it: `203[.]0[.]113[.]50`.
If any internal host communicated with it, isolate the host and capture volatile memory before reimaging: `203[.]0[.]113[.]50`.
expected.how_sure: Moderate. 5 of 5 source lookups answered, and no single source flagged the lead indicator strongly: its score comes from several weaker signals.

expected.bottom_line: No action. This is a P5: record the result and close.
first_steps: No containment action required. Record the triage result against the ticket and close.
expected.how_sure: There was nothing to look up.
